title: 'Jellyfish' probe the radar beam and are seen flying in a pair
place_text: Skywatcher site, about 6 km to the north and south

tellings.quote: received, and then in in February for the first time saw how two " "Jellyfish" fly together on the radar

plain: Objects nicknamed "Jellyfish" for their shape have been picked up on radar about 6 kilometres north and south of a site run by Skywatcher, a startup that tries to call in UFOs and track them. The company's team says they saw these objects probing their radar beam, and that in February 2025 they saw for the first time "how two Jellyfish fly together on the radar." They tell it as their own observation, which would mean the objects react to being watched and sometimes travel in pairs.
